//: The package at its own floor. Run it as the FIRST of two passes:
Where a new file goes. This config includes whole DIRECTORIES, so
anything added under src/, tests/ or tools/ is covered here with no
edit. pyrightconfig-hook39.json is the opposite — an explicit file list —
and it must name every file the recall HOOK can reach at import time,
which today is the one file it lists. So: add a module the hook imports,
add it there too, or its 3.9 floor is unchecked and the failure lands on
a stock macOS as a hook that silently retrieves nothing. Add anything
else and there is nothing to do.
The direction matters and is easy to invert: cli.py imports the hook,
which does not put cli.py on the hook's import path. The list is about
what the harness's python3 will execute, not about what depends on it.
